chunks: From him, from Abu Talib, raising it, said,

Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'Do not look at the length of the man's bowing and prostration, for that is something he has become accustomed to; were he to leave it, he would feel strange because of it. But look at the truthfulness of his narration and the repayment of his entrustment.'
ai.seo_question: What should one prioritize over the length of prayer movements according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) directs believers to prioritize the substantive ethical pillars of truthfulness (sidq) and trustworthiness (amanah) over the external duration of ritual bowing and prostration, which may merely be habitual. This hadith underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on inner integrity and practical reliability as the true markers of faith, distinguishing genuine piety from mere ritualistic form. It serves as a critical criterion for evaluating the character of individuals in both spiritual and social contexts.
